validation: This mutation violates the Bluetooth Core Specification v5.3, Vol 3, Part H, Section 2.3.5, which mandates that smp_pairing_confirm_pkt must be sent before smp_pairing_public_key_pkt, does not allow repeated sending of smp_pairing_public_key_pkt without an intervening response, and states that smp_encryption_information_pkt should not be sent until after smp_pairing_random_pkt.
